name: NightShot -- Sony DCR-TRV310E
_what_this_is: The analog tape simulator's NightShot calibration, as a DIFF against the schema defaults -- so every number here is one the reproduction actually depends on.
_factory_preset_this_was_built_on: broadcast_1992_weak  (apply it with POST /api/preset before or instead of this file; it is a PRESET, not a standard, and the two are separate fields -- writing it into `standard` is what made the first version of this file fail to import)

_calibrated_against.cut_map: 23s normal -> mode 1; 45-52s normal; 52-53s mode 1; 54-68s NIGHTSHOT 1; 68-83s NIGHTSHOT 2
_calibrated_against.the fair test: bare photographs only -- a camcorder frame is already the chain's own output, so feeding it back asks the chain to preserve a transformation rather than perform one
_calibrated_against.**measure at NATIVE resolution**: **Lateral chromatic aberration is a SUB-PIXEL displacement, so downsampling smooths it away.**  Measured on the case photograph, the hue spread by brightness band at 533x400 is 0.883 / 0.555 / 0.664 / 0.887, and at 1440x1080 it is **1.098 / 0.788 / 0.809 / 0.990** -- **the low-resolution rig was hiding 24% of the dark band and 42% of the mid band.**  Every earlier figure in this work was taken at 533x400, so a hue-spread number is only comparable with another taken at the same scale.  `tools/native_resolution.py` renders at the input's own size and prints the resolution beside every value.
_calibrated_against.**the basement image is a CG RENDER**: **It is not a camera**, so its spectral response, its noise and its dynamic range are a renderer's choices rather than a sensor's.  It is kept as a **synthetic control** and is not a calibration target; the targets are the camcorder's own frames.

_note_on_color_cast: **`color_cast`'s help text had its two directions reversed** and is corrected: measured on a neutral grey field through the chain, c -0.50 gives B/R 0.8369 (warm) and c +0.50 gives 1.1892 (cool), so **POSITIVE is cool/cyan and NEGATIVE is warm**.  The user spotted the contradiction between the label and the picture.
